<style>
/* Professional theme with teal accent */
body {
  background-color: #f8fafc !important;
  color: #334155 !important;
}

.top-bar {
  background-color: #0f172a !important;
  color: #e2e8f0 !important;
}

.top-bar:before {
  height: 2px !important;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0d9488, #6366f1) !important;
}

.top-bar a,
.top-bar__title,
.top-bar__menu-toggle-button {
  color: #94a3b8 !important;
}

.top-bar a:not(.--scroll-spy-active):hover,
.top-bar a.--scroll-spy-active,
.top-bar__menu-toggle-button:hover {
  color: #f8fafc !important;
}

.top-bar .--scroll-spy-active {
  border-bottom-color: #2dd4bf !important;
}

.top-bar__title-link {
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.menu {
  background-color: #ffffff !important;
  color: #475569 !important;
  border-right-color: #e2e8f0 !important;
}

.menu a {
  color: #64748b !important;
}

.menu a:not(.--scroll-spy-active):hover {
  color: #334155 !important;
}

.menu .--scroll-spy-active {
  color: #0f766e !important;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.content h1, .content h2, .content h3, .content h4, .content h5 {
  color: #0f172a !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.content h2 {
  padding-left: 0.75rem;
  border-left: 3px solid #0d9488;
}

.content hr {
  height: 1px !important;
  margin-top: 2.5rem !important;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0d9488, #cbd5e1, transparent) !important;
}

.content a:not(.header-link) {
  color: #0f766e !important;
  text-decoration-color: rgba(13, 148, 136, 0.35) !important;
}

.content a:not(.header-link):hover {
  color: #0d9488 !important;
  text-decoration-color: #0d9488 !important;
}

/* Subtle decorative backgrounds */
.content {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  overflow-x: clip;
}

.content::before,
.content::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
  opacity: 0.2;
}

@media screen and (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  body {
    background-color: #0c1017 !important;
    color: #cbd5e1 !important;
  }

  .top-bar {
    background-color: #070a0f !important;
    color: #e2e8f0 !important;
  }

  .top-bar:before {
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #14b8a6, #818cf8) !important;
  }

  .top-bar a,
  .top-bar__title,
  .top-bar__menu-toggle-button {
    color: #64748b !important;
  }

  .top-bar a:not(.--scroll-spy-active):hover,
  .top-bar a.--scroll-spy-active,
  .top-bar__menu-toggle-button:hover {
    color: #f1f5f9 !important;
  }

  .top-bar .--scroll-spy-active {
    border-bottom-color: #2dd4bf !important;
  }

  .menu {
    background-color: #0f1419 !important;
    color: #94a3b8 !important;
    border-right-color: #1e293b !important;
  }

  .menu a {
    color: #64748b !important;
  }

  .menu a:not(.--scroll-spy-active):hover {
    color: #cbd5e1 !important;
  }

  .menu .--scroll-spy-active {
    color: #2dd4bf !important;
  }

  .content h1, .content h2, .content h3, .content h4, .content h5 {
    color: #f1f5f9 !important;
  }

  .content h2 {
    border-left-color: #14b8a6;
  }

  .content hr {
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #14b8a6, #334155, transparent) !important;
  }

  .content a:not(.header-link) {
    color: #2dd4bf !important;
    text-decoration-color: rgba(45, 212, 191, 0.35) !important;
  }

  .content a:not(.header-link):hover {
    color: #5eead4 !important;
    text-decoration-color: #5eead4 !important;
  }

/* Hide h2 headers on topbar */
.top-bar__items ul:first-child {
  display: none;
}

/* Hide h1 header on sidebar */
.menu > ul:nth-child(2) > li > a,
.menu > ul:nth-child(2) > li li li li li a {
  display: none;
}

.menu li li a {
  padding-left: 1rem;
}

.menu li li li a {
  padding-left: 2rem;
}

.menu li li li li a {
  padding-left: 3rem;
}

/* Wider content width */
.content__inner {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  max-width: 80ch !important;
}

/* Add dot next to the number */
.content ol li:before {
  content: counter(count)'.' !important
}

/* Skip number increment on ul */
.content ul li {
  counter-increment: none;
}

/* Better bullet for li */
.content ul li:before {
  content: '◦' !important
}

/* Better margins for list */
.content ul, .content ol {
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.content ul li, .content ol li {
  margin-left: 1.5rem;
  padding-left: 1rem;
}

.content li ul li, .content li ol li {
  margin-left: 0.5rem;
}

/* limit image width for vertical images */
.content img {
  max-height: 700px;
}

/* Inline code */
.content code {
  background-color: #ecfdf5 !important;
  color: #0f766e !important;
}

/* Code block */
.content pre code {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  line-height: 1.2rem;
  background-color: #0f172a !important;
  color: #e2e8f0 !important;
}

@media screen and (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  .content code {
    background-color: #042f2e !important;
    color: #5eead4 !important;
  }

  .content pre code {
    background-color: #070a0f !important;
    color: #cbd5e1 !important;
  }
}

/* Same margin as outside details */
.content details,
.content details p {
  margin-top: 1rem;
}

/* Cursor pointer for details expand */
.content details summary {
  cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-decoration-thickness: 1px;
  text-underline-offset: 0.1875rem;
}

/* More margin at header bottom */
.content h1, .content h2, .content h3, .content h4 {
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.content h5 {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-style: italic;
}

/* Table */
table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  border-spacing: 0;
  background: #ffffff;
  color: #334155;
}

th, td {
  padding: 7px 12px;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
}

thead th {
  background: #0f172a;
  color: #f8fafc !important;
  font-weight: 600;
  border-bottom-width: 2px;
}

tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
  background: #f8fafc;
}

tbody tr:hover {
  background: #ecfdf5;
}

caption {
  caption-side: bottom;
  padding-top: .5em;
  font-size: .875rem;
  color: #64748b;
  text-align: left;
}

@media screen and (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  table {
    background: #0f1419;
    color: #cbd5e1;
  }

  th, td {
    border-color: #1e293b;
  }

  thead th {
    background: #111827;
    color: #f1f5f9 !important;
    border-bottom-color: #14b8a6;
  }

  tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .03);
  }

  tbody tr:hover {
    background: rgba(20, 184, 166, .08);
  }

  caption {
    color: #64748b;
  }
}
</style>
